versions.guide:
Find the settlement

The settlement of the tribe ruled by GoGo is in the west behind the hills, between the river bank and the swamps.

Steal the "sacred object"

The "sacred object" (a Goblin head on a pole) stands between the three fires. If you steal i, GoGo, the tribal chief, would indeed do his utmost to get the idol back.
versions.html:
Stealing "goblin sacred object"

To make the Goblin chief talk and reveal the secrets he knows, you must steal the idol belonging to the tribe - the skull of the First Goblin they worship.
